A world we grew up with.

An unofficial fan-made battle sandbox. Pokémon names and characters belong to their respective owners.

Pokémon sprites and game data: PokéAPI Sprites and PokéAPI. GBA front/back and classic DS battle sprites: PokéAPI. Later-generation pixel sprites: Pokémon Showdown community. Pokémon cries: PokéAPI Cries. Mega forms use directional SpriteCollab sheets where available. Transformed-form GBA pixel art and walking poses come from pokeemerald-expansion, sequenced with this app’s attack choreography. Attack sprites and ORAS battle music: Pokémon Showdown. Directional sprites and portraits: PMDCollab SpriteCollab (individual credits bundled with each sprite). Arena tiles: Mystery Dungeon tilesets. Environment details: pret/pokeemerald. Move sound effects are synthesized for this experience. Asset availability does not confer ownership of Pokémon media.

Use Clean 9:16 view to screen-record the portrait stage; Escape exits it. Battle rules are simplified. Sprite movement and effects create cinematic attacks; this is not a reproduction of every move’s original game animation.

Eternamax animation sheets: SpriteCollab. Original artist credits, licensed CC BY-NC 4.0. Floating idle frames are reused for travel and the boss uses a frontal presentation.
